name: Captain Funnel
author: Devang Vachheta

sections.description:
Captain Funnel connects your WordPress and WooCommerce website to the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta and sends automated WhatsApp messages to your customers whenever an order status changes or a form is submitted. No third party gateway, no unofficial WhatsApp automation tool, and no manual copy pasting of phone numbers. Everything runs directly from your own WordPress admin dashboard using Meta’s official API.

Captain Funnel is built for store owners, WooCommerce sellers, course creators, membership sites, agencies, and marketers who want reliable WhatsApp order updates, booking confirmations, membership alerts, and form response messages without depending on a paid SaaS subscription.

This plugin is a free, open source tool. Every feature described on this page is fully available with no paywalls, upsells, or locked functionality.

YouTube Tutorials | Facebook Community | Free Support

Automated WooCommerce Order Notifications

Automatically send a WhatsApp message to your customer every time their WooCommerce order status changes. Captain Funnel supports Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, and Failed order statuses, so your customers always know exactly where their order stands without you lifting a finger.

Bulk WhatsApp Broadcasts

Send a single WhatsApp campaign to a large list of contacts in one go. Broadcasts support hundreds of contacts per campaign, can run using your own custom WhatsApp Cloud API app or the plugin’s global Settings credentials, and can be sent immediately, scheduled for a future date and time, or set to repeat automatically every month. A full run history keeps track of every broadcast you have sent, including delivery status per contact.

Funnels : Multi Step WhatsApp Automation

Build multi step automation sequences that send a series of WhatsApp messages over time. Each step in a funnel supports its own configurable delay, so you can welcome a new customer immediately, follow up a day later, and send a review request a week after that, all without any manual work once the funnel is set up.

Message Templates With Dynamic Variables

Write your own WhatsApp message content using an easy template editor. Insert dynamic variables such as customer name, order number, order total, order status, tracking number, delivery date, coupon code, billing address, and more, so every message feels personal even though it is sent automatically.

Wide Integration Support

Captain Funnel connects with a large range of WordPress plugins across several categories, so you are not limited to WooCommerce alone:

E‑commerce: WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads

Form Builders: Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator

Learning Management Systems: LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS

Membership Plugins: MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro

Booking Systems: Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking

User Management: User Registration

Custom Automation: A flexible integration for triggering messages from your own custom events

Each integration can be switched on or off independently from the Integrations screen, and the plugin’s built in integration registry keeps the enabled and available state consistent across the entire admin dashboard.

Detailed Message Logs

Every WhatsApp message Captain Funnel attempts to send is recorded in the Logs screen, including messages that were sent successfully, messages that failed, and messages that were skipped. This makes it easy to audit delivery, debug a broken template, or confirm that a customer actually received their order update.

Dark Mode And Light Mode Admin UI

The entire Captain Funnel dashboard, including Broadcasts, Funnels, Templates, Logs, Integrations, and Settings, supports both a light and a dark interface theme, so you can work comfortably in whichever mode you prefer.

Built With Accessibility In Mind

Captain Funnel’s React based admin interface has been through a dedicated accessibility pass across every screen, including proper labeling, keyboard friendly controls, and screen reader support, so store teams of any ability can manage their WhatsApp automation comfortably.

Token Expiry Detection

Meta WhatsApp Cloud API access tokens can expire. Captain Funnel automatically detects an expiring or expired token and sends an email notification to the site admin, so your WhatsApp automation never silently stops working without you knowing.

Failed Order Admin Alerts

Configure an admin WhatsApp number to receive a notification whenever an order fails to send its WhatsApp message, so you can step in and follow up with the customer manually if needed.

Require Phone Number At Checkout

Optionally require a phone number field at WooCommerce checkout, so every order has a valid number to send WhatsApp notifications to.

Test Message Button

Send a test WhatsApp message directly from the Settings screen to confirm your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials are configured correctly before going live.

Floating WhatsApp Chat Widget

Add a floating WhatsApp chat button to your site’s front-end with a guided setup wizard. Choose from four ready made popup styles, Classic, Minimal Glass, Team Card, and Message Card, each with a live preview so you know exactly how it will look before saving. Add multiple agents with their own name, department, and phone number, set business hours so the widget shows an offline message outside working hours, and control exactly which pages, post types, or devices the widget appears on.

Perfect for:

  • WooCommerce store owners who want automatic WhatsApp order updates
  • Course creators using LearnDash, Tutor LMS, or LifterLMS who want student notifications
  • Membership sites using MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, or Restrict Content Pro
  • Businesses using Amelia, Bookly, or MotoPress Booking for appointments and bookings
  • Agencies and marketers running WhatsApp broadcast campaigns for clients
  • Any WordPress site collecting leads through Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • Any website wanting a floating WhatsApp chat button so visitors can message the business directly

With automated order notifications, bulk broadcasts, multi step funnels, dynamic message templates, wide integration support, a floating WhatsApp chat widget, detailed logs, and a fully accessible dark and light mode dashboard, Captain Funnel gives you everything you need to run reliable WhatsApp communication for your WordPress or WooCommerce website using Meta’s own official API.

How It Works

  1. Enter your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials in Captain Funnel → Settings.
  2. Enable the integrations you want to use, such as WooCommerce, Elementor Forms, or LearnDash, under Captain Funnel → Integrations.
  3. Write your WhatsApp message templates using dynamic variables under Captain Funnel → Templates.
  4. Optionally build a multi step automation sequence under Captain Funnel → Funnels, or set up a bulk campaign under Captain Funnel → Broadcasts.
  5. Messages are then sent automatically whenever a matching event happens on your site, such as an order status change or a form submission.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Order Notifications : Automated WhatsApp messages for Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, and Failed order statuses
  • Bulk WhatsApp Broadcasts : Send campaigns to large contact lists immediately, on a schedule, or on a monthly recurrence
  • Funnels : Multi step WhatsApp automation sequences with per step delay support
  • Message Templates : Write custom WhatsApp messages using dynamic variables
  • 20+ Integrations : WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS, MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro, Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking, User Registration, and Custom Automation
  • Floating WhatsApp Chat Widget : Customizable floating chat button with 4 popup styles (Classic, Minimal Glass, Team Card, Message Card), a live preview setup wizard, multiple agents, a greeting popup, business hours, and page/device visibility rules
  • Message Logs : Track every sent, failed, and skipped WhatsApp message
  • Dark / Light Mode : Full admin dashboard theming
  • Accessibility Focused : Dedicated accessibility pass across the entire admin interface
  • Token Expiry Detection : Automatic email alert when your WhatsApp Cloud API token needs attention
  • Failed Order Alerts : Admin WhatsApp notification for failed order messages
  • Require Phone At Checkout : Ensure every WooCommerce order has a valid phone number
  • Test Message Button : Verify your API credentials directly from Settings
  • Built In Documentation : Setup guides for credentials and every supported integration
  • Version Rollback : Restore a previous plugin version directly from the WordPress admin

YouTube Tutorials

  • How to Get Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials : Step-by-step walkthrough for creating your Meta App and getting the Access Token, Phone Number ID, and Business Account ID needed to connect Captain Funnel.
  • Elementor Form to WhatsApp Automation in 2 Minutes : Learn how to connect Elementor Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Contact Form 7 to WhatsApp Automation in 3 Minutes : Learn how to connect Contact Form 7 to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Gravity Forms to WhatsApp Automation in 2 Minutes : Learn how to connect Gravity Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • WPForms to WhatsApp Automation : Learn how to connect WPForms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Fluent Forms to WhatsApp Automation in 3 Minutes : Learn how to connect Fluent Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.

Supported Integrations

E‑commerce: WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads

Form Builders: Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator

Learning Management Systems: LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS

Membership Plugins: MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro

Booking Systems: Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking

User Management: User Registration

Custom Automation: Trigger WhatsApp messages from your own custom events

Available Template Variables

Use these dynamic variables inside any Message Template to personalize your WhatsApp messages automatically:

{customer_name} `{order_number}` `{order_total}` `{order_status}` `{customer_phone}` `{customer_email}` `{coupon_code}` `{tracking_number}` `{delivery_date}` `{billing_address}` `{site_name}`

Integration specific variables are also available depending on the trigger, such as {student_name} for LearnDash, Tutor LMS, and LifterLMS, {member_name} for MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, and Restrict Content Pro, {sender_name} for form integrations, and {service_name} for booking integrations like Amelia.

Our Products

Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.

Captain Feed for YouTube : Display customizable YouTube feeds for channels, playlists, Shorts, search results, and individual videos directly on your WordPress website.

Captain Live Chat : Self-hosted live chat for WordPress with an agent inbox, offline lead capture, and analytics. Conversations stay in your own database, with no subscription and no external servers.

Getting Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials

Use the built in Documentation section inside the plugin admin for step by step guides on:

  • Creating a Meta Business Account : Learn how to set up a verified Meta Business Account
  • Getting WhatsApp Cloud API Access : Learn how to obtain your Phone Number ID, WhatsApp Business Account ID, and access token
  • Connecting WooCommerce : Learn how to enable and configure the WooCommerce integration
  • Connecting Form Plugins : Learn how to enable and configure Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator

Prefer a video? Watch How to Get Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials on YouTube for the same steps shown on screen.

External Services

This plugin sends data to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (graph.facebook.com) to deliver WhatsApp messages to your customers. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

  • Service: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API
  • URL: https://graph.facebook.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy-eea

By installing and configuring this plugin, you agree to the Meta WhatsApp Business Policy. Messages are only sent when explicitly triggered by site events, such as an order status change, a form submission, a funnel step, or a broadcast campaign you create. No data is sent without the site admin’s own configuration and intent.

Data sent to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API:

  • Customer phone number : Used to deliver the WhatsApp message
  • Message content : The message text configured by the site admin in Templates, Funnels, or Broadcasts

Visitor Privacy:

No data is collected, stored, or shared by the plugin author. All API credentials are stored locally in your own WordPress database. A transient is used to throttle token expiry notification emails to a maximum of once per day. No external tracking or analytics are performed by this plugin.

YouTube (admin screens only):

The plugin’s Dashboard shows tutorial video thumbnails loaded from img.youtube.com, and the Documentation screen embeds tutorial videos from youtube-nocookie.com (YouTube’s privacy-enhanced mode). These requests are made by the site admin’s browser while viewing those screens; site visitors are never affected. No site or customer data is sent.

  • Service: YouTube (Google LLC)
  • Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Source Code:

The full source code, including build tools, is included in the plugin package under the src/ directory. Build instructions are provided in package.json.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/captain-funnel/, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Captain Funnel → Settings and enter your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials.
  4. Enable the integrations you need under Captain Funnel → Integrations.
  5. Write your WhatsApp message templates under Captain Funnel → Templates.
  6. Optionally set up Funnels for multi step automation or Broadcasts for bulk campaigns.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Meta Business Account?

Yes. You need a verified Meta Business Account with WhatsApp Cloud API access. See the built in Documentation section inside the plugin for step by step instructions.

Is it free to use the WhatsApp Cloud API?

Meta offers a number of free service conversations per month. After that, pricing is per conversation by country. See https://business.whatsapp.com/products/platform-pricing for current pricing set by Meta.

What is the difference between Text and Template message types?

Text messages are free form but only work within a 24 hour customer service window after the customer last messaged your business number. Template messages are pre approved by Meta and can be sent at any time, including as the first outbound message to a customer.

Can I send bulk WhatsApp campaigns to many contacts at once?

Yes. Use the Broadcasts screen to create a campaign, add your contact list, choose whether to send immediately, schedule it for later, or repeat it monthly, and pick between your own custom WhatsApp Cloud API app or the plugin’s global Settings credentials.

Can I send a series of WhatsApp messages over time?

Yes. Use Funnels to build a multi step automation sequence. Each step can have its own delay, so messages go out over hours, days, or weeks after the funnel is triggered.

Which plugins does Captain Funnel integrate with?

Captain Funnel integrates with WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS, MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro, Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking, and User Registration, plus a Custom Automation option for your own events.

Does this plugin store customer data?

The plugin logs message delivery status, including phone number, message content, status, and timestamp, in a local WordPress database table. This data is only used to display the Logs screen and is removed when the plugin is uninstalled.

What happens if my WhatsApp Cloud API token expires?

Captain Funnel automatically detects an expiring or expired token and sends an email notification to the site admin so you can refresh it before any messages are missed.

Can I be notified when an order fails to send its WhatsApp message?

Yes. Set an admin notification number under Settings and you will receive a WhatsApp alert whenever an order’s message fails to send.

Is the admin dashboard accessible?

Yes. Captain Funnel’s admin interface has been through a dedicated accessibility pass, including proper labeling and keyboard friendly controls, across every screen.

What is the Rollback feature?

The Rollback feature lets you safely restore the plugin to one of the previous available versions directly from the WordPress admin panel, without manually uploading plugin files.

Is WhatsApp a trademark?

WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Meta Platforms, Inc. or WhatsApp.
sections.changelog:
1.2.5 (05/11/2026)

  • New : Integrations Default Screen : Integrations is now the primary landing screen upon installation and activation, making it quick and intuitive to connect apps right away.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.2.4 (08/10/2026)

  • Fix : Plugin Notices On Captain Funnel Screens : The “WP-Cron is disabled” warning and the “enabled integration plugin is missing” warning were hidden on the plugin’s own screens; they are now shown at the top of the page content, clear of the sidebar, and follow the light and dark theme.
  • Fix : Switching Off A Missing Integration : An integration that was switched on but whose plugin is not installed showed a greyed-out, locked toggle, so it could not be switched off as the warning asked; the toggle now shows as on and can be switched off.
  • Fix : Site Name In Messages : The {site_name} variable, funnel messages, the test message, and the token expiry email sent the site title with HTML entities (for example “&” instead of “&”); the site name is now sent as plain text.
  • Fix : Broadcast Saving & Resending : Saving a broadcast without a credentials mode or recurrence no longer raises PHP warnings, and “Resend to All” / “Resend Failed” now return a clear error for a broadcast that no longer exists.
  • Fix : Broadcast Run History Filters : The Today, This Week, and This Month filters now use the site time zone.
  • Fix : Log Retention Time Zone : The automatic log cleanup now compares dates in the site time zone instead of the database server’s time zone.
  • Fix : Message Logs Pagination : Page number and page size are now kept within safe limits, preventing a database error on an invalid page, and log entries keep their source label after an integration is switched off.
  • Fix : WooCommerce Settings Visibility : The order status and “Require phone at checkout” settings, and the chat widget’s WooCommerce options, were hidden when the WooCommerce integration was switched off even though WooCommerce was active.
  • Fix : Chat Widget Device Visibility : The “Desktop only” and “Mobile only” options now also work on pages served from a page cache.
  • Fix : Chat Widget Assets : The chat widget’s CSS and JavaScript are no longer loaded on pages where the widget has no agents to show.
  • Security : Per-Form Settings Permissions : Contact Form 7 and Gravity Forms per-form WhatsApp settings now check that the user may edit that form before saving.
  • Security : Input & Query Hardening : The named template message type is sanitized before use, the logs query is built without interpolated SQL, and table names in the uninstall routine are passed through a prepared query.
  • Improved : Chat Widget Accessibility : The popup is announced as a dialog, the launcher button reports whether the popup is open, and the Escape key closes the popup and returns focus to the button.
  • Improved : Chat Widget RTL Support : Widget text now follows the page direction on right-to-left sites.
  • Improved : Privacy & Performance : The admin dashboard no longer loads a font from Google Fonts and uses the same system font stack as wp-admin, and documentation videos use YouTube’s privacy-enhanced mode.
  • Improved : Translations : API error messages, broadcast and log messages, and the token expiry email are now translatable.
  • Improved : Admin Menu Icon : The menu icon styles are now added through a registered stylesheet without !important.
  • Improved : Code Quality : WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) clean-up across the plugin, and the duplicated broadcast template-sending code now uses the shared sender.

1.2.3 (05/10/2026)

  • Fix : Custom Automation Post Published Error : Resolved a fatal error that occurred as soon as a template was saved for the “Post Published” notification, ensuring it now sends correctly.
  • Fix : Custom Automation Comment Approved Trigger : Fixed an issue where “Comment Approved” never fired on current WordPress versions; it now fires once upon comment approval, including those approved on submit.
  • Fix : Custom Automation Notification Triggers & Scope : Updated “Post Published” to cover public post types only and skip during imports, and ensured “User Role Changed” no longer fires for new registrations.
  • Fix : Contact Form 7 Duplicate Protection : Fixed an issue where a message was dropped for every other visitor of the same form for a minute after a submission, updating duplicate protection to rely on the submitted data.
  • Fix : Upgrade & Migration Repair : Fixed an issue where sites updating from versions before named templates retained the old unique key and missed the backfill of their message settings, ensuring the migration now runs before table updates to repair these sites.
  • Fix : Broadcast Duplicate Prevention : Contacts are now claimed before sending to prevent double clicks, second tabs, or cron events from sending the same message twice.
  • Fix : Broadcast Scheduling & Credentials : Scheduled broadcasts now send multiple batches per cron run and continue a minute later instead of waiting an hour, while invalid credentials properly stop the broadcast rather than marking contacts as failed.
  • Fix : Broadcast Recurrence & Time Zone : Monthly recurrence is now calculated from the previous run to prevent late finishes from skipping a month, invalid schedule dates are rejected, and the site time zone is displayed next to the time field.
  • Fix : Broadcast Tokens & Phone Number Validation : Custom tokens that expire no longer send the global token’s expiry email, and phone numbers longer than 15 digits are now skipped.
  • Fix : Order Notification Statuses : Fixed an issue where unticking all statuses in Settings still sent notifications, and ensured all statuses remain active by default before the first save.
  • Fix : Funnel Step IDs & Follow-Up Handling : Preserved step IDs when editing a funnel so queued follow-ups still send, and ensured follow-ups are skipped if the funnel or step is paused, or if the order is cancelled, refunded, or failed.
  • Fix : Funnel Message Backslashes : Fixed an issue where backslashes in step messages were incorrectly removed.
  • Fix : WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage Compatibility : Declared compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), updated tracking numbers and delivery dates to be read through the order object, and ensured billing addresses preserve their line separators.
  • Fix : WooCommerce Order Total Currency Entity : Fixed an issue where the order total incorrectly contained an HTML currency entity.
  • Fix : WPForms Toggle & Field Detection : Fixed an issue allowing forms to be toggled off again, and updated field detection to locate name and email fields by their field type.
  • Fix : Template Message Parameter Cleaning : Cleaned values containing line breaks, tabs, multiple spaces, or a pipe (|) before sending them as template parameters to prevent Meta parameter errors.
  • Fix : Bookly, Formidable, and Easy Digital Downloads Integration : Resolved fatal errors caused by missing methods in third-party plugins, and added full support for EDD 3 order status changes.
  • Fix : Floating Chat Widget Matching & Caching : Updated include and exclude lists to match pages and posts only, ensured the click counter functions correctly on cached pages, and stored the counter in its own dedicated option
  • Fix : Chat Widget WooCommerce Visibility Setting : Removed the unused WooCommerce visibility setting from the chat widget.
  • Fix : Message Logs ID & Result Persistence : Fixed an issue where clearing message logs reset log IDs, preventing queued messages from incorrectly writing their results to newer, unrelated rows.
  • Fix : Uninstall Data Cleanup : Ensured queued messages, Contact Form 7 per-form settings, and temporary data are properly removed upon uninstallation, while allowing data retention by adding define( ‘CAPF_KEEP_DATA_ON_UNINSTALL’, true ); to wp-config.php
  • Fix : Version Rollback : Built package addresses securely on the server, ensured users require proper permissions to install plugins, and respected disabled file modifications.
  • Security : Password Reset & License Key Logging Protection : Password reset links and license keys are no longer stored in the message log, and a reset message is restricted to at most once every five minutes per account.
  • Security : Form-Triggered Message Rate Limiting : Limited form-triggered messages to one per number and trigger per minute and ten per number per day, with both limits customizable using the capf_form_cooldown_seconds and capf_form_daily_cap filters.
  • Security : Integration Error Isolation : Errors inside individual integrations are now caught and written to the message log instead of interrupting the checkout, form, or post save process they ran in.
  • Security : Token Header Transmission & Phone Number ID Validation : The token used to check its own expiry is now sent securely in a request header, and Phone Number IDs are validated to ensure they contain digits only.
  • Improved : Phone Number Country Code & Formatting : Added a new Default Country Code setting where local numbers automatically receive the billing country’s code (from WooCommerce) or the default code, while numbers starting with + or 00 remain unchanged.
  • Improved : Custom Automation Webhook API & Validation : Webhook API keys can now be created directly from the integration page, and the endpoint now responds with an error when given an invalid phone number.
  • Improved : Privacy Policy & Data Management : Added suggested privacy policy text along with personal data export and erase tools for the message log, while automatically deleting log entries after 90 days (customizable via the capf_log_retention_days filter).

short_description: Send automated WhatsApp order notifications and form confirmations from WordPress or WooCommerce using the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.
description:
Captain Funnel connects your WordPress and WooCommerce website to the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta and sends automated WhatsApp messages to your customers whenever an order status changes or a form is submitted. No third party gateway, no unofficial WhatsApp automation tool, and no manual copy pasting of phone numbers. Everything runs directly from your own WordPress admin dashboard using Meta’s official API.

Captain Funnel is built for store owners, WooCommerce sellers, course creators, membership sites, agencies, and marketers who want reliable WhatsApp order updates, booking confirmations, membership alerts, and form response messages without depending on a paid SaaS subscription.

This plugin is a free, open source tool. Every feature described on this page is fully available with no paywalls, upsells, or locked functionality.

YouTube Tutorials | Facebook Community | Free Support

Automated WooCommerce Order Notifications

Automatically send a WhatsApp message to your customer every time their WooCommerce order status changes. Captain Funnel supports Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, and Failed order statuses, so your customers always know exactly where their order stands without you lifting a finger.

Bulk WhatsApp Broadcasts

Send a single WhatsApp campaign to a large list of contacts in one go. Broadcasts support hundreds of contacts per campaign, can run using your own custom WhatsApp Cloud API app or the plugin’s global Settings credentials, and can be sent immediately, scheduled for a future date and time, or set to repeat automatically every month. A full run history keeps track of every broadcast you have sent, including delivery status per contact.

Funnels : Multi Step WhatsApp Automation

Build multi step automation sequences that send a series of WhatsApp messages over time. Each step in a funnel supports its own configurable delay, so you can welcome a new customer immediately, follow up a day later, and send a review request a week after that, all without any manual work once the funnel is set up.

Message Templates With Dynamic Variables

Write your own WhatsApp message content using an easy template editor. Insert dynamic variables such as customer name, order number, order total, order status, tracking number, delivery date, coupon code, billing address, and more, so every message feels personal even though it is sent automatically.

Wide Integration Support

Captain Funnel connects with a large range of WordPress plugins across several categories, so you are not limited to WooCommerce alone:

E‑commerce: WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads

Form Builders: Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator

Learning Management Systems: LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS

Membership Plugins: MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro

Booking Systems: Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking

User Management: User Registration

Custom Automation: A flexible integration for triggering messages from your own custom events

Each integration can be switched on or off independently from the Integrations screen, and the plugin’s built in integration registry keeps the enabled and available state consistent across the entire admin dashboard.

Detailed Message Logs

Every WhatsApp message Captain Funnel attempts to send is recorded in the Logs screen, including messages that were sent successfully, messages that failed, and messages that were skipped. This makes it easy to audit delivery, debug a broken template, or confirm that a customer actually received their order update.

Dark Mode And Light Mode Admin UI

The entire Captain Funnel dashboard, including Broadcasts, Funnels, Templates, Logs, Integrations, and Settings, supports both a light and a dark interface theme, so you can work comfortably in whichever mode you prefer.

Built With Accessibility In Mind

Captain Funnel’s React based admin interface has been through a dedicated accessibility pass across every screen, including proper labeling, keyboard friendly controls, and screen reader support, so store teams of any ability can manage their WhatsApp automation comfortably.

Token Expiry Detection

Meta WhatsApp Cloud API access tokens can expire. Captain Funnel automatically detects an expiring or expired token and sends an email notification to the site admin, so your WhatsApp automation never silently stops working without you knowing.

Failed Order Admin Alerts

Configure an admin WhatsApp number to receive a notification whenever an order fails to send its WhatsApp message, so you can step in and follow up with the customer manually if needed.

Require Phone Number At Checkout

Optionally require a phone number field at WooCommerce checkout, so every order has a valid number to send WhatsApp notifications to.

Test Message Button

Send a test WhatsApp message directly from the Settings screen to confirm your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials are configured correctly before going live.

Floating WhatsApp Chat Widget

Add a floating WhatsApp chat button to your site’s front-end with a guided setup wizard. Choose from four ready made popup styles, Classic, Minimal Glass, Team Card, and Message Card, each with a live preview so you know exactly how it will look before saving. Add multiple agents with their own name, department, and phone number, set business hours so the widget shows an offline message outside working hours, and control exactly which pages, post types, or devices the widget appears on.

Perfect for:

  • WooCommerce store owners who want automatic WhatsApp order updates
  • Course creators using LearnDash, Tutor LMS, or LifterLMS who want student notifications
  • Membership sites using MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, or Restrict Content Pro
  • Businesses using Amelia, Bookly, or MotoPress Booking for appointments and bookings
  • Agencies and marketers running WhatsApp broadcast campaigns for clients
  • Any WordPress site collecting leads through Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • Any website wanting a floating WhatsApp chat button so visitors can message the business directly

With automated order notifications, bulk broadcasts, multi step funnels, dynamic message templates, wide integration support, a floating WhatsApp chat widget, detailed logs, and a fully accessible dark and light mode dashboard, Captain Funnel gives you everything you need to run reliable WhatsApp communication for your WordPress or WooCommerce website using Meta’s own official API.

How It Works

  1. Enter your Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials in Captain Funnel → Settings.
  2. Enable the integrations you want to use, such as WooCommerce, Elementor Forms, or LearnDash, under Captain Funnel → Integrations.
  3. Write your WhatsApp message templates using dynamic variables under Captain Funnel → Templates.
  4. Optionally build a multi step automation sequence under Captain Funnel → Funnels, or set up a bulk campaign under Captain Funnel → Broadcasts.
  5. Messages are then sent automatically whenever a matching event happens on your site, such as an order status change or a form submission.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce Order Notifications : Automated WhatsApp messages for Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, and Failed order statuses
  • Bulk WhatsApp Broadcasts : Send campaigns to large contact lists immediately, on a schedule, or on a monthly recurrence
  • Funnels : Multi step WhatsApp automation sequences with per step delay support
  • Message Templates : Write custom WhatsApp messages using dynamic variables
  • 20+ Integrations : WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS, MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro, Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking, User Registration, and Custom Automation
  • Floating WhatsApp Chat Widget : Customizable floating chat button with 4 popup styles (Classic, Minimal Glass, Team Card, Message Card), a live preview setup wizard, multiple agents, a greeting popup, business hours, and page/device visibility rules
  • Message Logs : Track every sent, failed, and skipped WhatsApp message
  • Dark / Light Mode : Full admin dashboard theming
  • Accessibility Focused : Dedicated accessibility pass across the entire admin interface
  • Token Expiry Detection : Automatic email alert when your WhatsApp Cloud API token needs attention
  • Failed Order Alerts : Admin WhatsApp notification for failed order messages
  • Require Phone At Checkout : Ensure every WooCommerce order has a valid phone number
  • Test Message Button : Verify your API credentials directly from Settings
  • Built In Documentation : Setup guides for credentials and every supported integration
  • Version Rollback : Restore a previous plugin version directly from the WordPress admin

YouTube Tutorials

  • How to Get Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials : Step-by-step walkthrough for creating your Meta App and getting the Access Token, Phone Number ID, and Business Account ID needed to connect Captain Funnel.
  • Elementor Form to WhatsApp Automation in 2 Minutes : Learn how to connect Elementor Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Contact Form 7 to WhatsApp Automation in 3 Minutes : Learn how to connect Contact Form 7 to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Gravity Forms to WhatsApp Automation in 2 Minutes : Learn how to connect Gravity Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • WPForms to WhatsApp Automation : Learn how to connect WPForms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.
  • Fluent Forms to WhatsApp Automation in 3 Minutes : Learn how to connect Fluent Forms to WhatsApp and send automated messages when a form is submitted.

Supported Integrations

E‑commerce: WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads

Form Builders: Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator

Learning Management Systems: LearnDash, Tutor LMS, LifterLMS

Membership Plugins: MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Restrict Content Pro

Booking Systems: Amelia, Bookly, MotoPress Booking

User Management: User Registration

Custom Automation: Trigger WhatsApp messages from your own custom events

Available Template Variables

Use these dynamic variables inside any Message Template to personalize your WhatsApp messages automatically:

{customer_name} `{order_number}` `{order_total}` `{order_status}` `{customer_phone}` `{customer_email}` `{coupon_code}` `{tracking_number}` `{delivery_date}` `{billing_address}` `{site_name}`

Integration specific variables are also available depending on the trigger, such as {student_name} for LearnDash, Tutor LMS, and LifterLMS, {member_name} for MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, and Restrict Content Pro, {sender_name} for form integrations, and {service_name} for booking integrations like Amelia.

Our Products

Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.

Captain Feed for YouTube : Display customizable YouTube feeds for channels, playlists, Shorts, search results, and individual videos directly on your WordPress website.

Captain Live Chat : Self-hosted live chat for WordPress with an agent inbox, offline lead capture, and analytics. Conversations stay in your own database, with no subscription and no external servers.

Getting Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials

Use the built in Documentation section inside the plugin admin for step by step guides on:

  • Creating a Meta Business Account : Learn how to set up a verified Meta Business Account
  • Getting WhatsApp Cloud API Access : Learn how to obtain your Phone Number ID, WhatsApp Business Account ID, and access token
  • Connecting WooCommerce : Learn how to enable and configure the WooCommerce integration
  • Connecting Form Plugins : Learn how to enable and configure Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator

Prefer a video? Watch How to Get Your WhatsApp Cloud API Credentials on YouTube for the same steps shown on screen.

External Services

This plugin sends data to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (graph.facebook.com) to deliver WhatsApp messages to your customers. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

  • Service: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API
  • URL: https://graph.facebook.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy-eea

By installing and configuring this plugin, you agree to the Meta WhatsApp Business Policy. Messages are only sent when explicitly triggered by site events, such as an order status change, a form submission, a funnel step, or a broadcast campaign you create. No data is sent without the site admin’s own configuration and intent.

Data sent to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API:

  • Customer phone number : Used to deliver the WhatsApp message
  • Message content : The message text configured by the site admin in Templates, Funnels, or Broadcasts

Visitor Privacy:

No data is collected, stored, or shared by the plugin author. All API credentials are stored locally in your own WordPress database. A transient is used to throttle token expiry notification emails to a maximum of once per day. No external tracking or analytics are performed by this plugin.

YouTube (admin screens only):

The plugin’s Dashboard shows tutorial video thumbnails loaded from img.youtube.com, and the Documentation screen embeds tutorial videos from youtube-nocookie.com (YouTube’s privacy-enhanced mode). These requests are made by the site admin’s browser while viewing those screens; site visitors are never affected. No site or customer data is sent.

  • Service: YouTube (Google LLC)
  • Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Source Code:

The full source code, including build tools, is included in the plugin package under the src/ directory. Build instructions are provided in package.json.
